7.description: Master Gerolt's reputation for excellence is, if anything, an understatement. His workmanship is exquisite─somehow both bold and breathtakingly delicate at the same time. Ah, I am privileged to behold such talent in such close proximity...

8.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA4ARMOR_00562_CRAFSMAN00532_100_020
8.description: Master Drake's designs require specialized materials, but if followed precisely, then it should be possible to imbue your armor with enhanced elemental might. Such an exceptionally brilliant technique!
